behaviour_cards.contract: The Router commits both slot maps and versions together; a named rejection preserves both byte-for-byte.

findings_promoted_to_tests: Displacement is a two-sided swap, never remove-then-add.
Stale version, empty source, or unknown destination changes neither Window.
Cross-Window drag suppresses the source View invalid local drop and publishes one Router transaction.
